nina_cs: Heads-up: AuroraMetrics dropped ~58% in query volume since 2026-02-10. Their product lead Priya accepted another role last week. Procurement introduced new contact (Elliot) and mentioned a ZephyrAI pilot. CFO is asking for a 'head-to-head' cost + quality summary before renewal. Need a sharp triage + quick enablement pack.

patrick_ae: Got it. Scheduled intro with Elliot + CFO tomorrow 11am PT. Can we get 7-day and 30-day top-50 queries, plus any recent eval flags? Also request any webhooks or ingestion changes on their side.

rachel_se: I'll run a sample of 2k recent requests for quality drift vs a Zephyr baseline. ETA 6 hours. If exact parity is requested, we should propose a short A/B with traffic split 15/85 for 72 hours.

dave_onboarding: Our trial runbook for competitor comparisons is archived under /playbooks/triage-v2 but it's missing a cost sheet. I can update slides + one-pager checklist by EOD. Should I include a migration timeline (hosted -> dedicated)?

infra-bot: Alert: account AuroraMetrics (acct_00712) usage down 58% since 2026-02-10. Monthly MRR exposure estimate: -$9,600. Last paid invoice: 2025-12-28.

nina_cs: Quick metrics dump I pulled from analytics: 
```json
{"7d_active_users": 38, "30d_active_users": 182, "avg_tokens_per_session": 950, "requests_30d": 12850, "drop_on": "2026-02-10"}
```

rachel_se: Early scan: precision on the top-entity extraction pipeline dropped ~9% after 2026-02-10. Could be a prompt tweak or small schema change. Need example payloads from their side to confirm.

patrick_ae: I'll ask Elliot for any recent config or model provider changes. Recommend we offer a 72h co-run with Zephyr (15% traffic) AND a short Redwood refresh: prompt tweaks + quantization profile to show cost delta. @liz_ops_manager can you pre-approve emergency credits?

liz_ops_manager: Approve up to $5k in credits for a short co-run if execs request. Also approve a follow-up digest QBR with Aurora execs if results are ambiguous.

dave_onboarding: Draft playbook uploaded (WIP) 1 link: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/aurora-triage-v1 (will add cost comparisons and migration checklist).

rachel_se: Plan: run A/B, compute quality delta and token-cost-per-1k for both sides, propose 2-3 prompt patches that reduce tokens while keeping F1 within 2 points. Will paste snippets here.

patrick_ae: Solid. Sync tomorrow 11am PT. If anyone hits blockers — post here. :rocket:
